title: Nikola Tesla
summary: Born on 10 July 1856 in Smiljan, then in the Austrian Empire and now in Croatia, Tesla worked in Europe as a telegraph drafter and electrician before emigrating to the United States in June 1884. In New York he developed an alternating-current induction motor, whose patents Westinghouse acquired. He became a US citizen in 1891 and died in New York City on 7 January 1943.

uncertainty.note: Birth date 10 July 1856 is given by IEEE and the US Department of Energy; the death date rests on the IEEE page alone.
